fixups_source: docs/datasheets/C409782_MHT151RGBCT.pdf p.2: the lens is 1.4 x 1.25 mm (diagonal 1.88 mm), and 'Recommended Solder Pad (Reverse Type)' has a 2.1 mm hole and 0.8 x 0.7 mm pads 2.3 mm apart, which puts the pad corners 0.12 mm from the hole. The hole is the datasheet's 2.1 mm; the pads sit 0.15 mm further out (centres at x +-1.70) so they keep 0.265 mm from the hole (JLC hole-to-copper 0.25 mm) and still overlap the LED's end terminals by 0.3 mm (phases 4-6 second review M3; the earlier 1.8 mm hole left the lens diagonal no room). EasyEDA's footprint has the pads closer together and no hole.
